thought.text: Password biasa tidak bisa IMAP. Saya cek apakah `sinaja.cyou` catch-all benar-benar sampai ke inbox yang kita punya aksesnya — pakai app password yang terbukti.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && timeout 150 python3 - <<'PY'
import imaplib
m=imaplib.IMAP4_SSL("imap.gmail.com",timeout=30); m.login("woybangsatkauuu@gmail.com","ftnhrjnivohmtvju"); m.select("INBOX")
typ,d=m.search(None,"ALL"); ids=d[0].split()
print("total pesan:",len(ids))
import collections
typ,d=m.fetch(b','.join(ids[-60:]),"(BODY.PEEK[HEADER.FIELDS (TO SUBJECT DATE)])")
raw=b"".join(x[1] for x in d if isinstance(x,tuple))
lines=[l for l in raw.decode(errors="ignore").split("\n") if l.strip()]
tos=[l for l in lines if l.lower().startswith("to:")]
print("contoh TO terakhir:")
for l in tos[-12:]: print("  ",l.strip()[:110])
PY
